履修条件
Students who have basic knowledge in Earth Science and apply the obtained data to their thesis.
授業概要
I will teach how to get and treat the data for rocks and minerals using our instruments,
Students will discuss their own data and make a presentation.
We may have field practice as well.
授業形態
（項目）
The class includes lecture of basis or each instrument, data acquirement, lecture of data reduction, and discussion of obtained data.
授業形態
（内容）
We teach abilities for field work, analysis, and data reduction that students need to make their thesis.
